    sep = next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if r and all(x==5 for x in r))
    colors = {x for r in g for x in r if x not in (0,5)}
    def cnt(color, above):
        idx = range(sep) if above else range(sep+1, len(g))
        return sum(1 for i in idx for x in g[i] if x==color)

            best, bestdiff = color, d
    n = len([c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[i][c] not in (0,5) for i in range(len(g)))])
    return [[best]*n for _ in range(n)]
'''
